content.text:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user operates as "Director" of an ML research project (faith-evidence-ie) targeting EMNLP 2026, managing an AI Agent that coordinates GPU experiments via Workers. The session focused on:
   - Cleaning up 6 stale RUNNING registry entries from May 21 (all had completed but weren't updated)
   - Starting DPO rebuilt 1-epoch eval on cuda:2 (W17 critical path for Table 2)
   - Running a multi-seed test eval cascade across 4 GPUs: 8B s43 no-evi → 4B s43 no-evi → 8B s44 with-evi → 8B s44 no-evi (on cuda:0), plus 1.7B s43 with-evi (cuda:3)
   - Researching LLM baseline numbers (AutoRE, GLiDRE) for paper table
   - Checking 14B s43 RSFT generation progress and preparing CED scoring cascade
   - Ultimately checking cuda:2 (DPO dev eval) and cuda:3 (1.7B s43 with-evi) completion and submitting next tasks (1.7B s43 no-evi + DPO 3ep training)

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **FREIGE**: LLM-based evidence-grounded DocRE system (3 contributions: RSFT+NLI, Decoupling spectrum, Evidence tax + variance compression)
   - **RSFT (Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning)**: Nested LoRA architecture — base model → merge SFT adapter → load RSFT adapter
   - **DPO (Direct Preference Optimization)**: 3-layer adapter stack — base → SFT merge → DPO LoRA. Training from CED-ranked pairs (2977 pairs, rank_by=ced_reward, min_margin=0.05)
   - **CED (Contrastive Evidence Distillation)**: NLI-based scoring for filtering RSFT candidates, k=1 top selection
   - **Evidence Tax**: Difference between with-evidence and no-evidence eval (negative = evidence helps). Calculated with matched@2048 token budget protocol

---
name: resource-saturation
description: "当你准备向 Director 汇报前、收到 cron/worker 回调、审批通过准备开跑、怀疑 Worker 池不够饱和时,立即使用本 skill。四部分:A) GPU 分配率(分配了没跑=失职) B) GPU 效率 C) 非 GPU 任务并行(Worker 池<2=失职) D) 汇报必须带 [资源] 行。"
always: false
roles:
  - director
  - agent
---

# 资源饱和度自检（硬约束）

## A. GPU 分配率检查

调 `get_project_resource_usage(project)` 看:
- 已分配给本项目的 GPU 总数和具体卡号
- 实际在跑任务的 GPU 数和具体卡号（交叉 registry RUNNING + nvidia-smi 进程）
- 分配了但没跑的 GPU 清单 ⚠️

任何"分配了但没跑"的 GPU = 失职。必须立即:
- 派 Worker 铺 dry-run / 下一批实验代码准备
- 铺 ablation（从 experiment-matrix 空白格子里挑）
- 确实无实验可铺 → 向 Director 汇报"暂无可铺实验"+ 建议下一步方向(扩 ablation 维度 / 加 baseline / 加 benchmark)。**不要建议归还 GPU**——项目级 GPU 归还只在归档时由 `archive_project` 自动触发, 不是 Director 中途的动作

**单实验不占多卡**: 分配 4 卡但实验只用 1 卡 → 另 3 卡必须并行跑其他实验,不能空占。

## B. GPU 效率检查

调 `get_gpu_health(server)`:
- 空闲 GPU（util < 10% 持续 > 5 min）→ 立即铺任务
- 低利用率（util < 50% 持续 > 15 min）→ spawn_worker 诊断（batch / IO / 同步）
- OOM 风险（显存 > 90% 持续 10 min）→ 主动降 batch / 调优

## C. 非 GPU 任务并行

GPU 在跑 ≠ 你空闲。以下 CPU / 网络任务**必须**派独立 Worker 并行:
- 下一批实验的数据集下载 / 预处理 / fingerprint
- 下一批实验的代码准备 / dry-run / 环境配置
- 论文文献调研 / related work 检索
- 已完成实验的 log 深度分析 / metric 聚合
- 论文章节起草
- 代码 review / refactor

**硬约束**: 任一时刻 Worker 池 < 2 个 = 失职（除非真的全部下游阻塞在等 GPU,这时应当向 Director 申请扩 GPU）。

## D. 汇报格式

向 Director 汇报时开头必须带资源声明行:

    [资源] GPU 分配 N / 实际在跑 M | Worker 池 K (其中 GPU 任务 A / CPU 任务 B)

- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch
